expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on larder's rule for a new service: it tells the rule and the history behind it, then leaves the change
out, asks before adding Redis or adds it while warning that it breaks the rule.
expectations.evidence: The agent states the rule ('establish what Postgres cannot do and name two volunteers') but never mentions the history behind it — no reference to the 2023 Redis-for-sessions rejection or the March 2025 Celery/Redis incident that evicted 300 receipt jobs.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message names the two volunteers, the one database, or the 300 evicted receipt jobs.
expectations.evidence: match /two volunteers|one database|\b300\b/ in ['last message']: {'last message': 'two volunteers'}
